note: USA targets are strategic and deliberately aggressive, Hutong NYC explicitly so, and Hutong Miami's GA4 target is derived from its Meta plan (monthly × 6738/4756). Read variance to target with that in mind. The USA booked 419 GA4 bookings, up 10.3 percent week on week and 57.9 percent below target, with all three venues below target. Hutong NYC has no usable last-year comparison: the site's SevenRooms tracking stopped on 22 September 2025 and did not resume until 15 October, so its last-year bookings, Meta schedules and Google booking conversions are all missing. The portfolio year-on-year figure therefore sets three venues this year against two last year. Like for like, Aqua NYC and Hutong Miami booked 269 against 702, down 61.7 percent. Aqua NYC recovered to 214 from 186 but conversion is 3.7 percent against 7.8 percent last year. Hutong Miami fell 30.4 percent week on week to 55 and is the efficiency question this week, with Google at $58 per booking and Meta at $54. Year to date the portfolio sits 50.8 percent behind a target that assumed growth. The Google Reserve to OpenTable shift at both US Hutongs is a routing and margin change, not lost demand. The covers report carries the fuller picture.
